title: Advanced Web Architectures & Cloud Services
description: Comprehensive exploration of distributed web architectures, REST APIs, microservices, containerization, and modern security patterns.

title: Relational Databases & SQL Optimization
description: Entity-Relationship modeling, relational algebra, SQL optimization, transactional integrity (ACID), indexing strategies, and normalization.

title: Applied Machine Learning & Deep Learning
description: Hands-on machine learning workflows: feature engineering, classification, neural networks, computer vision, and responsible AI governance.

title: Network Security & Applied Cryptography
description: Principles of computer security, asymmetric/symmetric cryptography, public key infrastructure, TLS, and defensive incident response.

title: Embedded Systems & IoT Interfaces
description: Microcontroller interfacing, real-time operating systems, sensor integration, low-power wireless communication protocols (MQTT, BLE).

title: Engineering Thermodynamics & Energy Systems
description: First and second laws of thermodynamics, closed and open system cycles, renewable energy transformations, and heat transfer basics.

title: Statistical Inference & Exploratory Data Analysis
description: Probability distributions, hypothesis testing, ANOVA, Bayesian statistics, data visualization, and exploratory modeling with R and Python.

title: Human-Computer Interaction & Accessibility
description: User-centered design principles, WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards, assistive technologies, cognitive walkthroughs, and usability evaluation.
